'''Mud Bricks''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × [[Mud Brick Slab]]) and a [[Stonecutter]] recipe (from [[Packed Mud]]). See {{MCW|Mud Bricks}} for everything else.
